rationale: Build entries by run 1-5: succeeded, succeeded, succeeded, succeeded, succeeded. Declared run-command probes: succeeded, succeeded, succeeded, failed, failed. Nonzero run probes lack required CLI arguments or standard input. They show incomplete invocation rather than a matched application-startup failure; scenario commands demonstrate operation when supplied valid inputs.
limitation: The declared commands were not re-observed with their required subcommands/input. Startup consistency cannot be inferred from these incomplete bare-command probes.

rationale: FR-023: importing malformed workspace JSON in run 2 prints an uncaught JSONDecodeError traceback. Run 3 reports a concise error identifying the property-name problem and its location. The recorded import-error presentation differs. Reviewed coverage: 16/36 requirements have an observed status in at least one run; 64/180 requirement-run cells have an observed status. These counts describe coverage, not stability.
limitation: This contrast is limited to the prepared malformed-workspace JSON case. Unobserved branches cannot establish further variation; no causal attribution to SRS omissions is made.

rationale: EX-001: a batch containing a valid PDF and a malformed PDF aborts in run 1 and produces no output. Run 2 skips the bad PDF with a warning and produces all three marked pages from the valid PDF. The recorded batch-preservation behavior differs. Reviewed coverage: 7/17 requirements have an observed status in at least one run; 26/85 requirement-run cells have an observed status. These counts describe coverage, not stability.
limitation: Other batch orders and damaged-input types were not exercised. Unobserved branches cannot establish further variation; no causal attribution to SRS omissions is made.
